text:
Alisa: Starting night handoff for regional rollout. US on at 00:30 UTC, EU at 02:00 UTC, APAC 07:00 UTC. Targets: keep p95 < 200ms, errors < 0.5%.
deploy-bot: deploy start: rollout v2.3.1 -> slices=[us,europe,apac] canary=1% stagger=30m
Jin (infra): Can we confirm warm pool in eu is at 65%? last check showed 52%.
Carlos (eng-sre): EU warm pool 65% now after warmup script. Memory pressure stable. Observability dashboards green.
Meera (product-ops): FYI: feature-flag still enabled for some customers; pinning required for EU if we hit regressions.
Noah (oncall): Adding rollback triggers to the runbook: if latency spike > 120% of baseline for 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 3m -> rollback.
Alisa: OK pin rule: if EU sees >0.8% errors after canary -> pin to v2.2.8 and hold APAC. Agree?
Carlos (eng-sre): agree. Also set deploy-bot throttle to 0.5x for APAC warmup window.
deploy-bot: throttle set: region=apac rate=0.5x
Jin (infra): Quick smoke: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.test/health` -> 200/ok on canary nodes.
Alisa: Perf probe: running synthetic load for EU canary now. 10s sample.
Carlos (eng-sre): Seeing a transient KV cache miss ratio increase, investigating. p95 tokens ~ 180ms.
Noah (oncall): If KV misses spike, we'll ramp cache priming script: `/scripts/prime-kv --namespace=eu --parallel=8`
Meera (product-ops): Noted. Also sending release notes summary to #customer-comms after APAC goes live.
Alisa: holdpoint at 02:15 UTC for EU review. If no issues, continue APAC warmup at 07:00 UTC with 15m stagger.
Carlos (eng-sre): I'm adding a temporary trace tag on canary: `region=eu_rollout_329001` for easier debugging.
deploy-bot: canary complete: eu=1% passed smoke. proceeding to 5% after hold.
Jin (infra): EU to 5% now. Warm-pool bumped to 80%.
Carlos (eng-sre): monitoring: errors 0.3%, p95 190ms, kv-miss back to baseline.
Alisa: greenlight for APAC warmup in 07:00 window unless any objections.
Noah (oncall): thumbs up. I'll be on pager for the window.
Meera (product-ops): Ready to block customers if we need to pin. Slack ping to customer-success on holdpoint.
Alisa: If rollback triggered in EU we pin and pause APAC. Keep release-notes draft ready.
Carlos (eng-sre): Logging decision point. If manual rollback needed: `deploybot rollback --version v2.2.8 --regions eu`.
deploy-bot: scheduled action: rollback command template saved in runbook.
Alisa: Thanks team. I'll post final status after APAC warmup. :rocket:
Meera (product-ops): Good run. Will prepare comms for 07:30 UTC post-mortem if needed.
Noah (oncall): staying on until +2h after APAC ramp.
Carlos (eng-sre): I'll follow up with a short heatmap of token latency across slices.
Alisa: thread closed unless new issues crop up.
